title: Marcus Vinicius's chain smoking after the event

tellings.quote: Oh, a lot. He even began smoking more. He'd smoke all day.

plain: After the 1996 events in Varginha, Brazil, where a hospital is said to have operated on an alien, a man named Marcos Vinícius is said to have been badly shaken and to have started smoking all day. A surgeon named Italo Venturelli, who tells Michels he was there, says Vinícius was affected "a lot" and "would smoke all day," a sign of how much the event troubled those close to it.
